summary: This note describes the song "I Feel Lucky" by American country artist Mary Chapin Carpenter, co-written with Don Schlitz. It was released in May 1992 as the first single from the album "Come On Come On" and reached number 4 on the Billboard Hot Country Singles & Tracks chart. The note also mentions a cover recorded by The Chipettes for the 1992 album "Chipmunks in Low Places".
one_line: A 1992 country single by Mary Chapin Carpenter, co-written with Don Schlitz, that peaked at number 4 on Billboard's country chart.
key_facts: "I Feel Lucky" is a song co-written and recorded by American country artist Mary Chapin Carpenter.
"I Feel Lucky" was released in May 1992.
"I Feel Lucky" was the first single from the album "Come On Come On".
"I Feel Lucky" reached number 4 on the "Billboard" Hot Country Singles & Tracks chart.
The Chipettes recorded a cover of "I Feel Lucky".
The Chipettes' cover of "I Feel Lucky" was included on the 1992 album "Chipmunks in Low Places".
"I Feel Lucky" was written by Mary Chapin Carpenter and Don Schlitz.
